#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json, time, requests, selenium.webdriver as wd

BASE = "http://localhost:8080"
API  = "http://localhost:8081/api/v1"
SANDBOX = "ep_run_now_test"

def click_run_now():
    driver = wd.Chrome(options=wd.ChromeOptions().add_argument("--headless"))
    driver.get(f"{BASE}/mcc/control")
    driver.find_element_by_id("workflow-select").send_keys("ep_basic")
    driver.find_element_by_id("run-now-btn").click()
    return driver

def get_job_status(job_id):
    r = requests.get(f"{API}/jobs/{job_id}")
    return r.json()["status"]

def get_price(mtok):
    r = requests.get(f"{API}/pricing?mtok={mtok}")
    return r.json()
